channels.label: ROC_LOC
channels.reason: Bipolar ROC-LOC eye derivation, so it maps to the generic EOG channel.

channels.label: LOC_ROC
channels.reason: This is the inverse of ROC-LOC and duplicates it; EOG is already assigned.

channels.label: F2_F4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain F2-F4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: F4_C4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain F4-C4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_P4
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain C4-P4 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: P4_O2
channels.reason: Bipolar EEG chain P4-O2 has no canonical counterpart.

channels.label: C4_A1
channels.reason: C4 referenced to the left ear/mastoid (A1) is the contralateral C4_M1 derivation.

channels.label: EMG1_EMG2
channels.reason: EMG1-EMG2 bipolar EMG with a 10-100 Hz filter is the chin EMG.

channels.label: ECG1_ECG2
channels.reason: ECG1-ECG2 is a bipolar ECG lead.

channels.label: TERMISTORE
channels.reason: Termistore is Italian for thermistor, the oronasal airflow sensor.

channels.label: TORACE
channels.reason: Torace is Italian for thorax, the respiratory effort belt.

channels.label: ADDOME
channels.reason: Addome is Italian for abdomen, the respiratory effort belt.

channels.label: Dx1_DX2
channels.reason: Dx (destra = right) bipolar EMG with a 10-100 Hz filter is the right leg EMG.

channels.label: SX1_SX2
channels.reason: Sx (sinistra = left) bipolar EMG with a 10-100 Hz filter is the left leg EMG.

channels.label: Posizione
channels.reason: Posizione is Italian for body position, recorded as a DC sensor channel.

channels.label: HR
channels.reason: Heart rate in BPM comes from the oximeter.

channels.label: SpO2
channels.reason: Oxygen saturation in percent comes from the oximeter.
